text:
ada: Quick thread: outage postmortem showed we can't trace batcher decisions through the model fanout. hard to answer: which batches caused CPU spikes in runtime and which were single-request fallbacks. thinking we need a compact "batch footprint" that survives fanout and reassembly.
paul: agree. current spans lose the edge's headers during fanout rewrite. footprint should be a tiny map: batch_id, batch_origin (edge|dedicated), batch_mode, batch_size_hint. attach to root span and propagate as baggage.
serena: baggage can be expensive in some tracers. alternative: add a single attribute on root + include batch_id in response logs for correlation. keep numeric counters in metrics only.
nina: also need to account for multi-model routing: when a request goes to primary model then falls back to smaller model, we should record both batch decisions. maybe an ordered list of batch_ids? that risks complexity. suggestion: root attribute primary_batch_id and fallback_batch_ids as comma list (rare).
kevin: storage query side: add a short-lived index on batch_id for 48h and a daily rollup table keyed by model, route, mode to answer cost spikes without scanning traces. index only for traces flagged diagnostic=true.
ada: (typo) ada: also we must avoid PII in token-level samples. sampled_token_events should only include counts (cache_hits, tokens_served) and hashed token fingerprints when necessary. no raw content by default.
paul: patch plan: 1) edge-sidecar: inject X-RW-BF header JSON-compact of footprint (or packed proto) 2) model-runtime reads header and stamps root span attribute rw.batch_footprint 3) logging layer writes response structured log with footprint 4) metrics emit rw.batch.choice{mode,model,route}.
serena: will PR a small shim. nina please add scrubber rules for sampled events and config toggle observability.batch_footprint.enabled (hosted=true, private=false).
kevin: will draft storage policy: index sampled traces for 48h, aggregate into batch_rollup_{day}. Requires onboarding docs for enterprise customers.
infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled for edge-sidecar v1.2.3 to staging at 3456789050 :rocket:
